import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Fix sex label variant
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip().str.lower()
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (handle commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # Filter out-of-range body_mass_g (min 2500, max 6500)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = np.nan
    # Keep only valid sex values
    df = df[df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female'])]
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    res = {}
    grouped = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g', 'sex']).groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    for k, v in grouped.items():
        res[k] = float(v)
    return res
